messages:
olga: Planning a short maintenance window tonight: staggered NIC micro-update + soft GPU process restarts in us-east2 + eu-west1. Window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Goal: knock down thermal tail spikes and fix intermittent pkt-drops.

ben: How much capacity will we take offline max? any reserved pools affected?

olga: Max concurrent GPU capacity loss target <5%. No reserved pools touched. Only interruptible and autoscale slots.

sam: Canary plan? who owns it?

olga: Canary on tenant small-ml-1. Two rounds: pass both -> continue. Devex owns validation.

devex: Canary criteria: 10m p95 within 15% of baseline and no error spike. I'll post results.

ben: Rollback triggers? p99 thresholds?

olga: Rollback triggers: p99 gen > 300ms for 5m OR +3% error-rate for 5m OR NIC drops >400/s for 2m. If hit, abort and backfill from warm-spare.

sam: Drain/reboot sequence suggestion: cordon -> migrate containers (30s grace) -> restart NIC fw -> restart inference workers -> smoke test -> uncordon. Prefer process restarts over host reboots.

olga: Agree. Preheat KV caches ~10m before each rack cordon. Script: `preheat --rack rc-11 --parallel 3 --keys /ops/cache/seed.txt`.

ops-bot: Incident stub created: INC-2026-1801 (tag: thermal-soft-restart). Dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/incidents/INC-2026-1801

devex: I'll run canary at 01:50 UTC and report. If green, kick at 02:00.

ben: I'll monitor SLOs and be ready to trigger backfill: `provisioner replace --tag warm-spare --max 25`.

olga: Thanks all. Post canary status here when done.
